protocol: Fresh post-implementation-freeze, same-owner source-informed scientific tasks. No queries or target IDs were used to tune the frozen implementation. Not blind, independent, or a held-out general search benchmark. Source families and some prior scientific context were already known; these formulations are new. Cases remain outside implementation regression fixtures. Five family slots per method; source correctness is assessed separately.

cases.query: Mother and daughter cell sizes have an unknown amount of independent camera noise. Can delayed size correlations still tell me how variable the inherited fraction is?
cases.needed_scope: Independent random-affine birth model, iid additive measurement noise, nonzero-lag invertible moment pencil; conditional variance identification, not a biological measurement.

cases.query: All of my candidate molecular attachments lose catalytic access at the same random instant. Why might adding more candidates reduce no-link failure only algebraically, and what changes if each batch gets a guaranteed initial active period?
cases.needed_scope: Shared exponential shutdown, independent retained grafts conditional on shutdown and Poisson candidates; guaranteed catalytic floor must be real.

cases.query: I reject a mismatched donor repeatedly, but it stays nearby and can bind irreversibly before it escapes. Can more sequential checking stages drive the wrong-product probability to zero?
cases.needed_scope: Declared competing-rate renewal model, return and premature bonding charged; nonzero leak floor, no physical rate acquisition.

cases.query: When a monomer fails to incorporate I retry the same synthesis step. The light pulse also occasionally unlocks later addresses. How should retry frequency enter the eventual correct-chain yield?
cases.needed_scope: Declared fresh-retry kinetic model; downstream exposure paid on every miss, not only successful cycles.

cases.query: For an extended conducting particle, I can reverse the uniform electric field and reverse its spatial gradient independently. Can four force readings isolate its linear polarizability without approximating the particle as a point?
cases.needed_scope: Fixed finite linear conductor and affine field, signed experimental projection; does not acquire passive sorting.

cases.query: A growing polymer remains covalently attached after denaturation. Does this alone justify a constant next-monomer encounter rate as the chain gets longer?
cases.needed_scope: Separate retained chemical progress from spatial re-registration; Gaussian unreset span carries length penalty, local anchoring requires acquired mechanism.

cases.query: All past adaptive observations use one sensor with an unknown fixed offset. Can infinitely many more readings from that same sensor remove uncertainty about a contrast measured with different future gains?
cases.needed_scope: Shared bias remains a common nuisance variable; repeated same-sensor observations cannot identify the observationally equivalent gauge.

cases.query: I need two jointly valid samples from a tagged permutation experiment. A witness is not supplied and I cannot invert the permutation. Could a shared random seed and forward evaluations generate the whole joint object instead?
cases.needed_scope: Verified common forward cover and exact native marginals; approximate alignment budget charged once for full tuple, no arbitrary inverse solver.

cases.query: I simulate a quantum particle on a semi-infinite nearest-neighbour chain. How can I bound the error caused by cutting off the chain separately from the numerical time integrator's tolerance?
cases.needed_scope: Bounded couplings and finite time, factorial tail from finite propagation; integration error remains separate.

cases.query: For a dielectric mixture in a cavity with fixed metallic mirrors, which response terms must a composition derivative bound retain, and can I simply assign a nonzero derivative to the zero Matsubara mode?
cases.needed_scope: Specified finite dielectric and fixed Drude/PEC mirror contract; response plus propagation derivatives, zero-mode derivative exactly zero in that scope.

cases.query: An intervention model passes eight fresh random checks after I chose it. Does the small bad-acceptance probability also certify the error conditional on passing, or does that require knowing how often models pass?
cases.needed_scope: Fixed candidate, invariant bounded-degree law and independent fresh grid tests; joint false acceptance is not a conditional-on-acceptance guarantee without yield.

cases.query: I can activate chosen groups of controls but cannot directly read pairwise coefficients. With a positive sparse quadratic interaction law and a warranted separation gap, can a few physical dose settings implement the group queries a sparse search needs?
cases.needed_scope: Actual three-setting source queries and error/gap resolution charged; quadratic law, positivity and sparsity required, not arbitrary causal networks.

cases.query: My two quantum states are normalized projectors onto subspaces of equal dimension. Is there a spectral-overlap route to a binary entropy bound using angles between the subspaces, without assuming the projectors commute?
cases.needed_scope: Equal-rank normalized projections are a supported special class; not arbitrary noncommuting density pairs; entropy uses bits.

cases.query: For tensor-product left and right supports in a multi-copy Werner problem, can local subspace overlaps certify positivity of every operator in that supported space? Does that settle unrestricted all-copy distillability?
cases.needed_scope: Local overlap condition applies only to product-defined support spaces and specified vectorization; unrestricted all-copy target remains open.

cases.query: Give an established universal worst-case speedup for unstructured NP-hard optimisation, counting data acquisition, failed attempts and the complete physical cycle.
cases.needed_scope: No positive answer without a source establishing every requested premise; irrelevant candidates must remain candidates, not a corpus-wide impossibility proof.

cases.query: Give a measured net-positive energy yield from a reusable thermal memory, with a completed preparation-and-reset cycle and a matched ordinary experimental comparator.
cases.needed_scope: Conditional mathematical memory constructions are not an acquired positive full-cycle experiment.

cases.query: Could a cell-lineage inheritance estimate survive camera errors that remain correlated across generations?
cases.operation: identify inheritance variance from delayed measured moments
cases.needed_scope: Existing iid-noise cancellation must not be transferred to correlated measurement errors; inspect assumptions rather than certify applicability.
